description: Get the rikma's own general conversation - the one thread that belongs to the whole rikma rather than to a single mission, act or decision. It is created the first time someone opens it. Use it for "what are we doing next" talk; anything about a specific mission, decision or profit split belongs in that thing's own thread, where it stays on record. Returns a forumId for readConversation and postConversationMessage. Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#openRikmaConversationTool
name: openRikmaConversationTool
